retrievalProfile.description: A structured 3x3 modular grid layout that alternates between close-up portraits, solid color blocks, and large-scale geometric typography.

recipe.visualDefinition: A clean, high-contrast 3x3 square grid separated by thick white gutters. The layout features five portrait shots of a single subject in various poses, two solid color blocks (pink and grey), and a central horizontal span containing large, stylized geometric typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Alternating portrait orientations within fixed square frames
High-contrast color blocks balancing photographic detail
Typography integrated as a structural element within the grid
coreInvariants: Uniform white gutter width between all grid elements
Perfectly square aspect ratio for each grid cell
Consistent lighting and subject across all portrait cells

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subject appears in five of the nine grid cells, primarily in the corners and top-middle, shown in medium close-up shots.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, dark-toned geometric text spanning the middle-right two cells acts as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye follows a clockwise path around the perimeter, starting from the top-left portrait and ending at the central text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Thick white gutters and solid color blocks provide significant breathing room and structural clarity.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Soft Pink and Warm Grey (solid blocks)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the red backgrounds contrasted against neutral white and muted accent blocks.

letterConstructionRules: Extreme horizontal expansion in display text
Open counters and simplified geometric forms
characterSpecificRedesigns: The letter 'R' features a detached leg or stylized diagonal
The 'E' uses three parallel horizontal bars of equal length
The 'A' lacks a crossbar or uses a low-slung geometric bridge
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A smaller, more condensed version of the same geometric face for secondary metadata text.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the square, wide geometric foundation

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a 3x3 grid of squares separated by thick white borders. Fill five squares with portraits of a woman with auburn hair against a red background. Fill one square with solid pink and one with solid grey. Leave the middle-right two squares empty/white.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Place large, horizontally-stretched geometric sans-serif text in the empty middle-right squares using a dark charcoal color.

verificationChecks: Is the gutter width consistent throughout?
Is the text horizontally expanded and geometric?
Do the portraits share a consistent lighting and color palette?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject

mustAchieve: Balanced distribution of color and imagery
Legible but highly stylized display type

postGenerationChecks: Ensure typography is stretched and geometric
Confirm color block placement matches the modular rhythm
recipe.reuseFormula: Modular Grid + Alternating Portraits/Color Blocks + Wide Geometric Type
